decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product that matches the firm's move toward connected and data-driven infrastructure management, its survival to 2022 suggests results have at least met aspiration levels or justified continued slack.

This product is still close to the established offer, but its weaker prominence and likely overlap with other data archiving solutions make it a more plausible candidate for later portfolio consolidation if performance falls short of aspirations.

The safety-oriented hardware add-on is less central to the firm's digital trajectory, yet as a complementary item in integrated infrastructure projects it can still be retained while delivering acceptable niche performance.

This appears the most peripheral and niche product in the set, so if its results are below aspiration it would be a natural target for problemistic search and resource reallocation, although its adjacency to the core business still argues for keeping it for now.

Flow measurement automation and system software fits the firm's strategic direction very well, and a product page plus continued market presence indicate enough promise to remain above aspiration or receive continued organizational support.
